definitions.explanation: The front part of the throat, from the base of the chin to the upper chest. Used both literally and in many figurative expressions.

examples.japanese: {喉元|のどもと}まで{出|で}かかっている。
examples.english: It's on the tip of my tongue.

examples.japanese: {熱|あつ}いものが{喉元|のどもと}を{通|とお}った。
examples.english: Something hot passed through my throat.

examples.japanese: {喉元|のどもと}{過|す}ぎれば{熱|あつ}さを{忘|わす}れるというが、あの{苦|くる}しさは{忘|わす}れられない。
examples.english: They say you forget the pain once it passes, but I can never forget that suffering.

notes:
Composed of {喉|のど} (throat) + {元|もと} (area around). Refers to the front of the throat, a vulnerable and sensitive area. Appears in several well-known proverbs and idiomatic expressions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {喉元|のどもと}{過|す}ぎれば{熱|あつ}さを{忘|わす}れる: once the heat passes the throat, you forget the pain — people quickly forget hardship once it's over
- {喉元|のどもと}まで{出|で}かかる: to be on the tip of one's tongue — almost able to recall something
- {喉元|のどもと}に{突|つ}きつける: to hold (a blade) to someone's throat — to press someone hard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喉|のど}: throat — the general body part; {喉元|のどもと} emphasizes the front surface area
- {胸元|むなもと}: chest area — slightly lower, around the upper chest and neckline
- {首元|くびもと}: neck area — the area around the neck, including the sides and back
